name: Local-first e-ink app suite for Boox Palma 2

mentions.name: Local-first e-ink app suite for Boox Palma 2
mentions.description: This is a suite of cloud-based, local-first apps optimized for e-ink tablets, specifically the Boox Palma 2, covering notes, book reader, browser, music player, maps, camera and more, with a companion iOS app combining them all so the user can disconnect and just grab the Palma and go.
mentions.problem: Wanting to disconnect and go with just an e-ink device instead of the phone.
mentions.audience: Wanting to disconnect and go with just an e-ink device instead of the phone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A suite of own cloud based local first apps optimized for eink tablets, specifically the boox palma 2. Notes, book reader, browser, music player, maps, camera etc. With a companion ios app combining all of them.

this way when i want to disconnect i can just grab the palma and go
